# TDC Digital Advisory

> Independent enterprise advisory for AI governance, digital transformation,
> SAP S/4HANA delivery and test management. Senior-led by Tanja Drefke,
> Transformation Advisor and Executive Delivery Lead.

TDC Digital Advisory LLC is a Wyoming limited liability company serving
enterprise clients under complex regulatory obligations, from board-level
strategy through hands-on design, build and implementation. Engagements are
led personally by the founder rather than staffed to a delivery team.

## Three pillars

- **Advisory & Transformation** — strategy, AI governance, enterprise
  transformation and interim executive advisory.
- **Delivery & Engineering** — implementation across SAP, cloud and digital
  products, supported by test management and automation.
- **Intelligence Lab** — independent applied research, currently developing a
  digital health platform that brings personal health information,
  observations and goals into one structured view.

## Practices

- **AI Governance & Regulatory Readiness** — AI lifecycle governance, risk and
  controls, human oversight.
- **Strategic & Digital Advisory** — digital and AI strategy, due diligence,
  portfolio governance.
- **Enterprise Transformation** — operating model design, programme and PMO
  leadership, change and adoption.
- **Digital Transformation Services** — SAP S/4HANA, cloud and integration,
  rollout readiness.
- **Test Management & Automation** — corporate test strategy, SIT and UAT,
  automation roadmaps.
- **Digital Product Engineering** — websites, web applications and first usable
  versions of digital products.

## The 4D approach

1. **Discover** — what is actually blocking progress; a prioritised risk and
   readiness assessment.
2. **Design** — who does what, in which order; an agreed roadmap with
   responsibilities and dependencies.
3. **Deliver** — what proves readiness to go live; test results, a rehearsed
   cutover plan and remaining risks.
4. **Drive** — whether the team can run it without TDC; named operational
   owners and a knowledge transfer plan.
